model.name: In-room chat works + tapping the room title opens room settings (@390)
model.description: TWO in-room fixes, each pinned @390 in-room. (1) IN-ROOM CHAT WORKS - a REAL regression: the in-room chat sends AND receives messages again. Architect root: R31.9 observePosition + R31.4 drawer-lifecycle changes hit the UN-GATED in-room chat drawer (RoomView uses the shared rb-detail-drawer as chatPanel per R30.20); the drawer refactor broke the chat panel mount/render. FIX = room-chat OPT-OUT (the in-room chat drawer opts out of the observePosition/detail-container lifecycle that broke it), preserving the R31.4/R31.9 drawer wins (positioning!=function, shared behavior). (2) TAPPING THE ROOM TITLE OPENS ROOM SETTINGS - an ADD-AFFORDANCE, NOT a regression: architect MEASURED the room title NEVER had a click handler - the pencil affordance always opened the S19 room-settings modal; the title was inert. Tron ruled to ADD it: tapping the room title opens the SAME S19 settings modal the pencil opens (~3-line rb-header title-click -> same modal). Tron called both 'regressions' verbatim; the architect measurement corrects #2 to an add (Rule 11: Tron's words preserved, the measured truth annotated). Feature-fix route: architect diagnosed -> expert building both -> tester gates @390 IN-ROOM. These slipped because the R31.4/R31.9 drawer gate never covered the IN-ROOM flow (missing-AC).

acceptanceCriteria.text: @390 IN-ROOM: the chat WORKS again - the user can SEND a message and RECEIVE messages in-room. REAL REGRESSION (worked pre-R31.4/R31.9): the R31.9 observePosition + R31.4 drawer-lifecycle changes hit the un-gated in-room chat drawer (RoomView chatPanel on the shared rb-detail-drawer, R30.20), breaking the chat panel mount/render. Fix = room-chat OPT-OUT of the observePosition/detail-container lifecycle; the R31.4/R31.9 drawer wins (Server Manager / trace) MUST still hold (positioning!=function).

@390 IN-ROOM: tapping the ROOM TITLE opens the room-settings modal - the SAME S19 settings modal the pencil affordance already opens. ADD-AFFORDANCE, NOT a regression: the architect MEASURED that the room title never had a click handler (the pencil always opened settings; the title was inert). Tron ruled to ADD it (~3-line rb-header title-click -> same S19 modal). No new modal - reuse the existing one.

The re-gate @390 MUST cover the IN-ROOM flow (chat send/receive + room-title->settings-opens), NOT only /trace + Server Manager - the regression slipped precisely because the R31.4/R31.9 drawer gate never exercised the in-room path (missing-AC). Regression-check: the R31.4/R31.9 drawer wins still hold (no re-break). Tron device re-verify in-room.
